sentences.text: Mobina Khatun @ Mobina Khatoon & Ors vs Unknown on 16

Author: Tirthankar Ghosh
Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh
16.04.2024

Serial no. 9-11 [G.S.D] Crr 1387 of 2024 In the Matter of : Mobina Khatun @ Mobina
Khatoon & Ors.

With Crr 1440 of 2024 In the Matter of : Md. Sahid @ Shahid Raza & Ors.
With Crr 1441 of 2024 In the Matter of: Sadab Banu @ Shadab Bano & Anr.
... ... Petitioners Mr. Satadru Lahiri Mr. S. Shivam Mr. V. Prasad ... for the petitioners Mr. Debasish
Roy Mr. Arijit Ganguly Ms. Sreemoyi Roy ... State Mr. Kunal Ganguly Mr. P. Mukherjee ... for the
O.P.

As the subject-matter of the three revisional applications involve Shibpur P.S. Case No. 109 of 2024 dt. 14.3.2024 with similar prayers, the three revisional applications are taken up for analogous hearing.
Report submitted by the State be kept with the record.
The Case Diary has been produced by the ld. Public Prosecutor, appearing on behalf of the State.

The three revisional applications relate to quashing of Shibpur P.S. Case No. 109 of 2024 dt.
14.3.2024 under sections 420/467/468/471/496/120B/506 of the IPC.
The genesis of the case arose out of matrimonial dispute and discord and so far as the theme of the allegations which is the genesis of the case for cheating and forgery is concerned relate to a declaration which has come to the knowledge of the complainant lately in the year 2024.
The fact of the case is that the petitioner/Sadab Banu @ Shadab Bano suppressed her first marriage and before the appropriate authority denying him second marriage which was registered, declared that the same was her first marriage.
Having considered the nature of the allegations and the manner in which the whole of the family has been implicated, I am of the view that although a case has been made out for investigation but the custodial detention of the petitioners may not be warranted in the facts and circumstances of the case until and unless the investigating authority arrives at a finding regarding the truth or falsity of the contents of such allegations.

With the aforesaid directions, all the three revisional applications being CRR 1387 of 2024, CRR 1440 of 2024 and CRR 1441 of 2024 are disposed of with a direction that the investigating authority would continue with the investigation and submit their report under section 173 of the cr.p.c.
